- Pool3 mean: 0.7715

Actually, looking more carefully:
- The full pool mean (19 models) is best at 0.6788
- The full pool median (19 models) is 0.7866 - worse
- The full pool dba is 0.6825 - very close

The fact that mean > dba > weighted > median suggests that the simple averaging of all models is already doing a good job of diversification. With unstable rankings, no single model or small subset is reliably better.

Given the stopping rule explicitly states to accept when the leader is a seed and verdict is indistinguishable, I should accept. The justification should be in terms of observable series characteristics.
